content:
lee: Heads up — onboarding tenant 'orca' hit two blockers in eu-west-2: ENI/IPv4 pool exhausted for the subnet + p5.xlarge (actually p5.48xlarge req) quota is zero for this account. Need coordinated quota bump and a short-term fallback plan.
anita: Ugh. Which account? new org account or shared infra account?
lee: new-org-348 (linked with billing org). We tried launch and got these errors: 
lee: ```
ERROR: Could not create network interface: InsufficientCapacity
ClientError: 'You have insufficient device capacity for the requested instance type'
ERROR: ServiceQuotaExceeded: You have exceeded your quota for Network Interfaces (ENIs).
```
carl: @lee can you paste the current service-quotas request IDs? Did you open a support case?
lee: opened case #1234567890 with AWS with high priority. Also requested Service Quotas increases for: p5 family, p4d, and g5. CLI we used for reference: 
lee: ```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 4 --region eu-west-2
# L-1216C47A = Running On-Demand g instances (example)
```
maria: Quick note — ENI exhaustion usually from very low subnet / wave of warm pools. What's our subnet CIDR? Can we temporarily use a /22 instead of /24 for the onboarding VPC?
lee: subnet is /24 right now. Changing to /22 requires infra change and a PR to onboarding playbook. Short-term we can: 1) move the tenant to shared warm IP pool in the infra account, or 2) spin instances in eu-west-1 where quotas exist.
anita: Cost note — moving to on-demand in another region will spike network egress and cross-region costs. We should estimate.
carl: Also watch ENI per-AZ limits. Sometimes AWS gives capacity but still blocks in particular AZ. Request should include per-AZ capacity ask and ENI quota increase (L-F6789A1B).
lee: AWS-support-bot: "We have received case 1234567890. Assigned to TAM. ETA for initial response: ~4 hours." :eyes:
maria: For the p5/p4d/g5 quotas, include example instance counts and purpose in the request form. AWS is more likely to approve if we say "onboard warm pool: 3x p5.48x + 2x p4d.24x for evaluation" and mention we're a platform company with reserved capacity planned.
anita: Can we fall back to g5 for initial smoke tests? Should be cheaper for small runs.
lee: We tested g5.2x and g5.12x — perf regressions for our long-context evals. Might be ok for dev, but production needs p5/p4d.
carl: Ops workaround: create a small warm pool in the infra account (already has quotas) and cross-account role to allow launching into that pool for onboarding tenants. That avoids immediate quota changes. Need IAM approvals.
maria: +1 on cross-account warm pool. Add a TTL for instances and a cost-tag so finance can track spin-up.
lee: I'll open a PR to the onboarding repo with instructions and a terraform module snippet. Draft command for cross-account role: 
lee: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "cross_launch" {
  name = "redwood-cross-launch-orca"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{ Effect = "Allow", Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root" }, Action = "sts:AssumeRole" }]
    Version = "2012-10-17"
  })
}
```
anita: Who's owning the PR and the support case?
lee: I'll own the PR. @carl can you own the AWS case follow-up and confirm per-AZ numbers with TAM?
carl: Yep. I'll push updates here when TAM replies.
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: onboarding-orca/warmpool-change — build #482 queued. :rocket:
maria: Also add a fallback in the onboarding workflow to skip GPU-heavy jobs if quota not available and notify tenant with a link to docs. Reduces noise.
lee: Good call. I'll add a feature flag "allow_gpu_fallback" to the onboarding job.
anita: Timeline?
lee: PR today, infra warmpool short-term hack within 6hrs, AWS case hopefully resolved in 24-72hrs. If not, we escalate to account manager.
carl: TAM just replied: "we can push p5 family to 6 in eu-west-2 and lift ENI by 500, but per-AZ checks remain. Please confirm desired AZ distribution."
lee: Confirmed: prefer even spread across eu-west-2a/b/c, target: p5 total=6 (2 per AZ), p4d=2 (spread), g5=10 for fallback, ENI additional 500.
maria: Added cost tag requirement: tag=onboarding:tenant=orca, owner=lee, ticket=1234567890
lee: Thanks all — will update thread with case # updates and PR link. :pray:"
